import os
from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u095/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[background for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            minr = min(y for y,x in cells); maxr = max(y for y,x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y,x in cells); maxc = max(x for y,x in cells)
            area = (maxr-minr+1)*(maxc-minc+1)
            if area >= 8 and len(cells) / area >= 0.75:
                for y in range(minr, maxr+1):
                    for x in range(minc, maxc+1):
                        out[y][x] = color
    return out
'''
program_file=program_dir/'task-f1fe51fa.py'
program_file.write_text(code)
